values.note: City campground page: RV sites nightly $40, weekly $225, monthly $450; boat slips $10 a night. The page carries no year (read 2026-10-21, site footer 2026).

fees.source: https://greatbendcampground.com/ (Rates & Sites: 'Nightly: $40 / Weekly: $225 / Monthly: $450'; 'Boat Slips: Nightly: $10'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://greatbendcampground.com/ ('Open year round'; Dates & Hours 'Open year-round'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://greatbendcampground.com/ ('RV Sites 1 - 13: 20/30/50 amp service, Water, sewer hookups'; 'Sites 14 - 18: 30 amp service / 110 electric, Water, sewer hookup'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Sites 1-13: paved back-in pads with 20/30/50-amp, water and sewer, lengths 80 ft (1-5), 70 (6), 60 (7), 30 (8), 40 (9-10), 38 (11), 33 (12), 35 (13). Sites 14-18: 30-amp/110-volt with water and sewer, 28 ft. One camping unit and two vehicles per site.

sites.source: https://greatbendcampground.com/ (Rates & Sites; Campground Policies) + Let's Camp camp data (maxRVLength 80 ft), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Book online through the city's Let's Camp page ('Reserve Now!'), or pay in person at the Ravenswood Municipal Complex or by phone at 304-273-2621 (Mon-Fri 8-4); a site counts as reserved once paid. Check-in 3 pm, check-out noon. No more than 14 consecutive nights.

booking.source: https://greatbendcampground.com/ (Campground Policies: 'Rental fees may be paid in person at the Ravenswood Municipal Complex ... or by calling 304-273-2621', 'The rental period for any campsite shall not exceed 14 consecutive nights') + Let's Camp camp data (status live, allowOnlineBookings, minNights 1), read 2026-10-21

note: City of Ravenswood (Board of Parks & Recreation) campground on Sandy Creek close to where it flows into the Ohio River, with 20 boat docks and an ADA kayak launch. Some RV sites sit directly along the water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the city's own campground site: year-round, 18 sites to 80 ft with water and sewer, reservable (Let's Camp). Changed electric 30 -> 50 (sites 1-13 have 20/30/50-amp). Added $40/night (undated page), per-site lengths, 14-night limit. Note corrected: the city puts it on Sandy Creek near the Ohio, not on the Ohio itself. Not stated: showers/restrooms (only dumpsters and a nearby community room listed), pull-throughs.
flags: Missing website: the city's campground site is https://greatbendcampground.com/ (Ravenswood Board of Parks and Recreation), booking at https://letscamp.ca/camps/great-bend-campground. The site gives 304.761.6666 in its header and 304.273.2621 or 304.532.5268 under Location; the entry's 304-273-2621 is the municipal complex where fees are paid.

Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator says the campground is 'Nestled along the Sandy Creek close to where it flows into the Ohio River'; the entry's riverfront call and old note put the sites on the Ohio. The water at the sites may be the creek (creekside) rather than the river.
